create_index_distributed_faiss: create a distributed faiss index client connecting to multiple server nodes for vector search
search_vector_index: search a distributed faiss index with query vectors and return top-k nearest neighbors
add_embeddings_to_index: add embeddings and metadata to a distributed faiss index with round-robin load balancing
search_with_filter: search a distributed faiss index and filter results by metadata field value
load_distributed_index: load a distributed faiss index from server nodes with optional config and force reload
